o1: Enables protein phosphatase binding activity. Predicted to enable protein phosphatase regulator activity. Involved in cortical actin cytoskeleton organization; establishment of mitotic spindle localization; first cell cycle pseudocleavage; and innate immune response. Is located in astral microtubule and cell cortex. Orthologous to several human genes including PPP6R3 (protein phosphatase 6 regulatory subunit 3).
